tasks.title: Runtime prompt and contract v3 full alignment
tasks.outcome: The runtime loads every model prompt from the canonical `prompts/*.md` files and the code schemas, working-memory structures, memory operations and model call outputs strictly follow the v3 contract in `lib/state/contracts.ts`. No hardcoded prompt prose remains in `lib/ai/*.ts`.
done_when: A prompt loader in `lib/ai/prompts/` reads the markdown files under `prompts/` and returns the canonical operational text for Interviewer, Sensemaker wave, Sensemaker futures/final, Prototype and Chat; no prompt markdown is edited.

`lib/ai/interviewer.ts` replaces its inline `makePrompt()` with the loader, passes the v3 input envelope and uses `interviewerProposalSchema` for all three modes (open_wave, continue_wave, propose_deep_dive).

`lib/ai/sensemaker/wave.ts` replaces its inline `insightSchema` with `waveSensemakerProposalSchema`; the model returns `operations` and `insight`, and the host applies the operations after validation.
`lib/ai/sensemaker/final.ts` (and any futures/ordinary-day helpers) use the canonical v3 prompts and the `FinalPlan` / parallel-life schema from `lib/state/contracts.ts`.
`lib/ai/sensemaker/chat.ts` uses the canonical v3 chat prompt and `sensemakerChatOutputSchema`.

`lib/working-memory/types.ts` and `schema.ts` are aligned with v3: ImmediateInsight has `user_told_me`, `current_reading`, `important_unknown`, `radar_deltas`, `route_impact`, `evidence` as `EvidenceLink[]` and `language_strength`; MemoryOperation uses v3 op names (`add_claim`, `update_radar`, etc.).
`build-wave-patch.ts` is retired or rewritten so that evidence, claims, constraints, route intents and radar deltas come from the model proposal; host owns id assignment, validation and fallback.
`app/api/wave/route.ts`, `app/api/feedback/route.ts` and `app/play/page.tsx` consume the new v3 wave output shape without breaking guest session and consent flow.
All integration, contract and E2E tests pass; fixtures and test answers are updated to match the new v3 schemas and question IDs.
boundaries: Do not edit `prompts/*.md`; they are the canonical v3 source.
Do not invent new v4 contracts; use `lib/state/contracts.ts` as the v3 authority.
Do not make the model assign host-owned ids, timestamps or provenance; host assigns them after the proposal is accepted.
Do not silently fall back to hardcoded plan text; a degraded model output must be visibly provisional or empty.
Preserve guest session, upload privacy, consent and visual system as-is.

progress.next: Build the prompt loader and reconcile working-memory types with v3 contracts
